pe_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium shot frames the young woman in an ornate red hanfu with white and gold crane embroidery exactly as shown in <Picture 1> — eyes closed, right hand resting on the dark carved wooden railing, long red ribbons and sheer sleeves streaming in the wind, the low sun on the horizon behind the wide river with sailboats, the pavilion eave and hanging bell framing the right side. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed throughout, no cuts. From 0 to 3 seconds, she keeps her eyes closed as the wind lifts her hair and ribbons; her shoulders and back sink gently, fingertips tapping the railing softly; she slowly turns her upper body to the right, opens her eyes and gazes toward the distant boats and horizon, then eases back to center as hair and red ribbons fan freely. From 3 to 6 seconds, her hands fold softly in front and her body sinks slightly; her arms open slowly sideways into the wind, wide sleeves billowing; her right wrist traces a slow downward wave as her waist sways right, then her left sleeve falls as her waist twists left and returns. From 6 to 9 seconds, she rises on tiptoe, both hands lifting slowly upward as if reaching to hold the setting sun; she sways gently left and right with arms raised, then lowers her hands while bending gracefully to the right, returns upright and leans slightly left, her red skirt spreading in the sunset light. From 9 to 12 seconds, she turns slowly and lightly, her upper body rotating back in a half-turn that briefly shows her back to the river — a lonely silhouette — then she turns back, her right hand opening outward in a wistful gesture, her left hand rising as if seeing off the departing boats. From 12 to 15 seconds, her weight shifts slightly forward, her eyes lifting to the sunset and far hills; her hands draw inward and settle at her waist, her spine straightens as the wind fills her red sleeves, and finally she closes her eyes and stands perfectly still, matching the opening framing — a solitary, beautiful stillness as the clip ends.

overall_soundscape: A steady river breeze sweeps continuously across the high pavilion, rustling silk sleeves and hair ribbons in soft fabric whispers. Faint water lapping and distant creaks of wooden boats drift up from below, with a single soft chime from the hanging eave bell and the light tap of fingertips on the wooden railing.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse, slow guzheng notes with a deep, steady drum pulse on the main beats, joined by a low xiao flute line that swells gently through the middle and fades into a long sustained note at the end.
